start: New phone, welcome screen, a MettleUp backup in the member's Google Drive

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and choose the account
user_sees: 'Checking your Google Drive for a backup…'
Button 'Restore my backup' and 'Not now'
must_not: Anything on the phone changed by looking

steps.action: Tap 'Restore my backup'
user_sees: 'Bringing back your backup…'
The app opens on the restored workouts
must_not: A half-restored phone when a step fails
The welcome left waiting with no word

start: Settings, Backup and restore, 30 workouts on the phone, 2 of them not in the Drive backup

steps.action: Find the backup and ask to restore it
user_sees: The question says '2 workouts on this phone are not in this backup and will be removed. A copy of this phone is kept first, so you can undo it.'
must_not: Workouts removed without being counted first

steps.action: Confirm, then within 24 hours tap undo the last restore
user_sees: 'This puts back what was on this phone before the last restore.'
With workouts saved since: 'N workouts saved since the restore will be lost.'
must_not: Undo offered with no copy behind it
Newer workouts lost without that line

start: Drive holds a backup an older version wrote (database only)

steps.action: Find the backup and restore it
user_sees: The workouts come back the old way; photos stay as they are
must_not: A corrupt or foreign file restored
The member told photos came back

start: Welcome, Google account with no MettleUp backup; and a phone short of room

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google'
user_sees: 'No MettleUp backup in your Google Drive yet. Tap Next to set up the app.'
must_not: An endless spinner

steps.action: On a nearly full phone, restore a found backup
user_sees: 'Could not save a copy of this phone’s data first (is the phone full?), so nothing was changed.' or a line saying how much room is needed
must_not: The phone data replaced with no safety copy

steps.action: On an empty fresh phone, back up now
user_sees: The back-up is refused with a plain reason
must_not: An empty phone pushing over a real backup in Drive

steps.action: Look for undo the last restore
user_sees: Undo is no longer offered
must_not: An old copy put back that takes newer training away

steps.action: Restore made over the demo, then undo within 24 hours
user_sees: The demo comes back, marked as demo
must_not: The demo coming back as real data

start: Member with a Drive backup, also in a gym

steps.action: Restore from Drive
user_sees: The backup is read from the member's own Google Drive only
must_not: The gym seeing the backup or its contents
A new backup quietly written to Drive
